skills.name: real-world-evidence-study-designer
skills.description: Designs EHR, claims, or registry RWE studies with explicit time zero, exposure and outcome windows, censoring, confounding control, and target trial emulation.

skills.name: clinical-cohort-protocol-designer
skills.description: Builds retrospective or prospective cohort protocol frameworks: eligibility, time zero, follow-up, endpoints, variable tiers, and one primary analysis line.

skills.name: confounder-and-bias-control-planner
skills.description: Classifies variable roles, selects a minimal adjustment set and control strategy, and flags mediator, collider, immortal-time, and selection bias before analysis.

skills.name: case-control-study-planner
skills.description: Frames case-control designs with source-population logic, control sampling, matching decisions, exposure timing, and a bias-control matrix.

skills.name: clinical-data-cleaner
skills.description: Runs SDTM-style DM, LB, and VS data checks: required-field validation, outlier flagging, ISO 8601 date standardization, and a JSON audit trail.

skills.name: nhanes-clinical-retrospective-biomarker-research-planner
skills.description: Plans NHANES-style cross-sectional biomarker association studies with spline and subgroup modules, optional hospital validation, and four workload tiers.

skills.name: sample-size-and-power-planning-assistant
skills.display_name: Sample Size and Power Planning Assistant
skills.description: Writes assumption-audited sample size, event-count, precision, and fixed-N feasibility memos with fallback scenarios instead of false-precision numbers.

skills.name: table-1-generator-advanced
skills.description: Generates an unweighted baseline characteristics table from a CSV: mean and SD, median and IQR, n (%), with t-test, ANOVA, or chi-square by group.

skills.name: univariate-multivariable-cox-regression
skills.description: Runs complete-case univariate and multivariable Cox models in R, exports hazard ratio tables, and draws forest plots.

skills.name: km-survival-curve
skills.description: Draws Kaplan-Meier curves in R for a precomputed categorical group with log-rank or Wald p-value, confidence bands, and a risk table.

skills.name: epidemiology
skills.description: Guides occurrence measures with person-time denominators, absolute and relative association measures, DAG-based confounder reasoning, and bias checklists.

skills.name: reporting-guideline-compliance-checker
skills.description: Checks manuscripts against STROBE, CONSORT, PRISMA, or TRIPOD and ranks missing or weak reporting items by submission risk.
